title: ci(required-contexts): register Dogfood Regression Gate as a required context again
body:

_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiNjyvCdXYygFqntMNR7S2dW)_
Part of #30461

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

**Tier H** (`AGENTS.md`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`; `.claude/**` rides along). Draft until an approval from GOVERNED_APPROVERS. This is step 3 of ruling 6669982756: the `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` row merges first, then the maintainer adds `Dogfood Regression Gate` to the `main` ruleset the same day. #30461 stays open until that ruleset edit, so this PR does not close it.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：把 `Dogfood Regression Gate`(ci.yml 的 `dogfood-gate`)重新登记为必过检查：注册表加一行，必过名单从 10 个变 11 个,AGENTS.md、seat 读数表和说明文档同步改，旧墓碑注释改成一行"已回归"的历史。不改任何 CI 任务、条件或超时。
- 为什么改：裁决 6669982756(A,分两步)。24 小时读数已过阈值(6707277208):373 次队列构建，flake 0 次，中位时长降 1.6 分钟，两次拦下的都是真回归。
- 风险与回滚：本 PR 只改注册表和说明文字，合入本身不改变队列行为;你在 ruleset 加上这一项后,dogfood 红才会把队列条目弹出。回滚：从 ruleset 删掉这一项，再 revert 本 PR。合入到你改 ruleset 之间，必过集巡检(Live required-set sweep)会出一条"方向 A"警告，不阻塞、不通知任何人。
- 先看:`scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs` 新增的注册行和改写的墓碑注释;`AGENTS.md` 第 507–512 行的名单。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs`,应看到 `11 required context name(s)` 和 `ci.yml:dogfood-gate → 'Dogfood Regression Gate'`。
- 需要你做的：批准本 PR;合入当天在 Settings → Rulesets → `main` 的必过检查里加上 `Dogfood Regression Gate`。

## What changes

- `scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs`
  - One `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` row: `ci.yml`, `dogfood-gate`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`. Its `authorized` names ruling 6669982756 and the 24-hour reading 6707277208. Its `carries` names the sharded `Dogfood Regression Gate (k/3)` matrix read through the aggregate, and the `Dogfood Verify CLI` leg that its `if:` skips on merge_group and pull_request. Same row shape as the `Test UI` precedent (833e4a8972).
  - The #22998 tombstone now covers `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` alone; its substance is unchanged. The dogfood half is one `Returned:` line that keeps the history (dropped by #22998, back by #30461).
  - Both `statesTheSet` surfaces' `mustName` gain `Dogfood Regression Gate`. The two history comments read `10→11` / `the eleven`.
  - Self-test: battery (3) gains the bare-name rename fixture (`Dogfood Regression Gate (aggregate)` ⇒ red, naming `dogfood-gate`). Battery (9) gains the shard-name collision fixture (a `dogfood` shard wearing the bare name ⇒ red) and the coexistence control. The ruleset-snapshot comment now says only Temporal reads as unpinned.
- `AGENTS.md` (merge-queue rule) and `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md`: the required-set list goes from ten to eleven. `check:required-contexts` is red until both name the registry exactly. The count words are followed by hand, and both files keep their line counts (ratchet headroom 0, every line ≤120 bytes).
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/review-checklist.md:49`: was "dogfood 门禁不跑于 PR 与队列" (stale since #30639). It now reads `dogfood 门禁不跑于 PR、跑于队列,全绿 PR 照样被队列弹出。` The line is 118 bytes, and the file keeps its 76-line ceiling.
- `docs/agents/multi-agent-discipline.md`: "outside those ten" becomes "eleven". The two-speeds paragraph no longer calls the queue dogfood red advisory.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: comments only. THE TWO SPEEDS and the `dogfood-gate` header said the context is outside the required set and its name is unpinned, and this row makes that false. No job, `if:`, timeout or step changed.

Not changed, because the row does not make them false:
- `scripts/check-aggregator-roster.mjs`: `REQUIRED_AGGREGATORS` already lists `ci.yml/dogfood-gate`, and its header already counts five required-context aggregators.
- `fleet-patrols.yml`, `governed-surface-guard.yml`, `pr-body-guards.yml` and `lint.yml`'s `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` cross-reference.
- The dated readings in `cross-repo-issue-closer.yml`, `publish-smoke.yml` and `docs/audits/gate-census-2026-09.md`.

## Tests

- `node scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs --self-test`: 190 assertions pass, including the three new fixtures. Each fixture asserts its own anchor matched, so a no-op mutation would fail.
- `node scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs`: 11 pinned, `ci.yml:dogfood-gate → 'Dogfood Regression Gate'`.

## Acceptance notes

- **The window between this merge and the ruleset edit.** The required-set sweep (`fleet-patrols.yml` job `Live required-set sweep`) will report `Dogfood Regression Gate` in direction A: registered here, not yet live. That covers this PR's own Fleet Patrols run (it triggers on `scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs`) and any scheduled sweep (04:23 / 16:23 UTC) before the edit. Direction A exits 0. The job stays green and adds one `::warning::` annotation. It writes no issue, label or comment and pages nobody. The reading is the sitting's reminder, and it clears once the ruleset carries the context. No fix is proposed.
- **Until the ruleset edit, a dogfood red still does not eject a queue entry.** `AGENTS.md` and the docs already describe the state after the edit, as the `Test UI` and `Live E2E UI` rows did.
- The fuse in ruling 6669982756 step 4 is unchanged: three or more flake ejections in one day allow reverting #30639, which takes the gate back to zero expected credentials without a ruleset change.
- `review-checklist.md:49` had been stale since #30639, and round 2 (`bacd70b11e`) rewrote it. It now reads as the state after the ruleset edit, the same convention as `AGENTS.md`.

## Verification

Head: `bacd70b11e` (round 2 added the `review-checklist.md` line, and the same 82 gates were re-derived and rerun, all exit 0). `origin/main` was merged once before opening (already up to date at `5f00374492`). `main` at `af3451b08b` touches none of the six files, and merge-tree is clean.
